update_procedure: Land the change in Pulp first.
Copy Pulp's tools/scripts/nm_symbols.py at that Pulp commit byte-for-byte to tools/mirror/nm_symbols.py.
Set pulp_commit to that commit and git_blob to `git -C <pulp> rev-parse <commit>:tools/scripts/nm_symbols.py`.
Run python3 tools/mirror/test_verify_mirror_inertness.py, with VELLUM_PULP_ROOT=<pulp checkout> to also compare against Pulp itself.
